findings.quote: Under it were forty-one more in his own hand, the newest a hind in the North Ferriby cut. He entered the forty-third beneath them.
findings.problem: Minute count wrong: ch1 left 42 own-hand entries beneath Keld's; draft says forty-one existing then enters the forty-third (41+1 is 42). Uses the card's stale figure.
findings.fix: Change 'forty-one more' to 'forty-two more' so the new entry is the forty-third.

findings.quote: He considered the Register, and the girl with the case, and the man's hands.
findings.problem: Josse's interior act stated flat, no external tell for Wystan to observe.
findings.fix: 'He looked at the Register, then at the girl with the case, then at the man's hands.'

findings.quote: He shrugged, and it cost him nothing.
findings.problem: Narrator certifies Josse's inner state rather than Wystan inferring it from behaviour.
findings.fix: Replace with an external correlate, e.g. 'He shrugged, easy, and went back to the block.'
